comment: Pattern guide skeleton: docs/patterns/planning-chain.md in Agent-kit. The planning chain's label set. Rename a label to your own vocabulary but keep its rule, then delete this key. Create each with: gh label create <name> --color <color> --description <description>. GitHub allows 100 characters in a description, so the longer rule is kept here, beside it.

labels.name: prd
labels.description: A planned feature; its slices are its sub-issues
labels.rule: One per planned feature. Its body holds the assembled-branch gate, and the gate's verdict is posted on it.

labels.name: tier:mechanical
labels.description: Slice gate tier: every mechanical criterion holds
labels.rule: Exactly one tier label per slice. With none, the slice is not ready.

labels.name: tier:standard
labels.description: Slice gate tier: one behaviour change on one surface
labels.rule: Exactly one tier label per slice. With none, the slice is not ready.

labels.name: tier:full
labels.description: Slice gate tier: a new module, a public contract or a high-risk area
labels.rule: Exactly one tier label per slice. With none, the slice is not ready.

labels.name: afk
labels.description: A builder can finish this slice without a person
labels.rule: Exactly one of afk or hitl per slice.

labels.name: hitl
labels.description: A person decides first; see the slice's Decision needed section
labels.rule: Never dispatched. Once the decision is written in the slice, a person swaps it for afk and the dispatch label.

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Dispatch label: may start once every Blocked by issue is closed
labels.rule: Only on an afk slice. A dispatcher starts an open slice that has it, is not integrated, and whose blockers are all closed.

labels.name: ready-for-human
labels.description: A person acts next: a hitl slice, or a slice held open
labels.rule: A slice whose run did not end clean is held open with this label and a comment listing what was left. Its dependents wait until a person closes it.

labels.name: integrated
labels.description: Its commits are on the assembled branch; never dispatched again
labels.rule: Set on integration, whether or not the run ended clean. It is what keeps a re-run from building the slice twice.
